title: Fix stale statements found in S165 review (README, PROJECT, boundaries, state, design, dashboard)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S165 review found statements that disagree with the code: README.md:22 says the Waves screen is later work (it exists); PROJECT.md:3 says spec only, no code; docs/boundaries.md:38 says v7 today and :77-78 says no merge, push or tag in v1 (landing is in ork); docs/state.md:77-78 says check_minutes sets the stale flag and goes into briefs (it is only the check command's timeout, engine/states.go:198); docs/design.md:423-426 lists the states without land (runrec/record.go:31); docs/dashboard.md:12-13 promises mouse clicks (no mouse code until S66). Run after S142, which rewrites the contract wording in boundaries.md and design.md.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: No Go tests. Check by reading: each statement above matches the code or doc it cites after the edit.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Docs only. Re-anchor each line after S142 lands (line numbers move). Fix the six statements; for the mouse sentence say clicks are opt-in and arrive with S66 (*proposed*); for boundaries.md say what ork does at landing (ff-only merge, push when the project allows it, no tag) per docs/design.md:351-391. Not a UI slice.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: slicer check; adj lint; rg each cited sentence to confirm it is gone.
